mapper.select: SELECT dv.* FROM document_version dv INNER JOIN knowledge_document kd ON kd.document_id = dv.document_id WHERE kd.document_user = #{documentUser} AND dv.source_hash = #{sourceHash} AND kd.is_deleted = 0 AND dv.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY dv.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dv.* FROM document_version dv INNER JOIN knowledge_document kd ON kd.current_version_id = dv.document_version_id AND kd.document_id = dv.document_id WHERE kd.document_id = #{documentId} AND kd.is_deleted = 0 AND dv.is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
